plainText:
The Final Match and a Surprising Finale! (Japanese: 決勝！！ 意外な結末！ It's Decided!! An Unexpected Conclusion!) is the seventh chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
 
and Gladion continue their battle.
Moon learns about regional forms from Samson Oak.
Gladion defeats Moon and advances to the final round.
and Gladion begin their battle against each other.
A mysterious energy shoots from the crack in the sky and hits the Sparkling Stone on Sun's wrist.
The energy allows to fire a powerful that defeats Gladion's .
Sun passes out from exhaustion.
The Iki Town festival tournament ends
Gladion leaves and reveals that his goal is to defeat the Ultra Beasts.
The next day, Sun awakens on a boat with the island challenge amulet, where he meets the .
